quests.title: 1dollar
steps: Do you have the coins we seek? Bring a 1 Dollar Coin to me and test your luck!
Only a pro can see the true value of coins. That coin you're carrying couldbe worth millions!
Test your luck and bring me a 1 Dollar Coin!
Ohhh you brought a 1 Dollar Coin? Let's see your luck today...
Unfortunately, your coin was a fake one. No reward for you I'm afraid, sorry.
Here's your reward.
Here's your reward. It seems your bag is full however, so some of the rewards were put within your Merchant Board.
Something wrong happened, please contact a Game Master (make sure you tell him the current server time).

quests.title: 50cent
steps: Do you have the coins we seek? Bring a 50 Cent Coin to me and test your luck!
Test your luck and bring me a 50 Cent Coin!
Ohhh you brought a 50 Cent Coin? Let's see your luck today...

quests.title: alchemy
steps: Good Morning sir.
So, you are interested in Alchemy?
I'm going to teach you the basics of potion making.
Later on, you will be able to make health recovery potions, mana recovery potions, poison potions and numerous other types of potions.
Alright, as your first task, I'd like you to make 20 Cups. After all, what is an alchemist without recipes?
Bring 20 Cups in order to complete this quest.
Alright, let's see if you are able to use these cups
Make 20 Small Healing Potions as your first alchemy test and come back. Don't buy these from the shop, I'll know it !

quests.title: Archaeologist
steps: Hello. What? Why are you staring at me? Do I look familiar?
I am too great to speak with someone like you. Do not speak to me until you are at least Dual 1.
Why of course I do! I'm the most famous archaeologist in all of Dragoon! What? What's all this treasure you ask?
You see, my latest travels took me to Seeker's Tower to study the ancient Seraphims. I was able to recover some artifacts before their guardians drove me and my team away.
I'd love to study what's in these treasure chests... but the Seraphims hold the key to openening them.
You look like a desperate chap looking for a job. How about helping me out? I'll split what ever's inside 99-1.
What? That sounds like a bad trade? But you'll be helping moi, the most famous archaeologist ever!
Wait! Wait! Don't leave. How about I put your name down in the credits too? How can you pass up the fame of having your name next to mine?

quests.title: arenabuff
steps: You are already protected by Save from Danger.
You are already empowered with Enchant Weapon.

quests.title: blacksmith
steps: You saw my wanted ad and want to work for me?
Okay! Let's see if you qualify. Make me 20 Double Daggers!
Craft and bring 20 Double Daggers in order to progress in your job.
Ha very good. If you past the next one you're hired!
Need those 20 Double Daggers..I can always find someone else you know.
Ok if you pass this you're hired! Make me 20 Cleavers!
Craft and bring 20 Cleavers in order to progress in your job.
Well you proved to be the best of the bunch. You're hired! Minimum wage.

quests.title: bowmaker
steps: They might say a bow is a cowards weapon but I say it is the wiseman's weapon. Do you agree?
So you think so too? Ok I'll teach you all I know! First make me 20 Short Bows
Bring 20 Short Bows in order to complete this quest.
The strings a little tight but its ok.
Show me you have talent and I'll let you do some real work! Make me 20 Long Bows
Bring 20 Long Bows in order to complete this quest.
Not bad, but this is still the basics. You'll have to learn more to work in my shop!
Okay, I'll give you an easy order to start on.

quests.title: butcher
steps: You want to learn how to butcher? Well you better like seeing blood then!
Let's start you off with something simple! Bring me 20 Beef!
Bring 20 Beef in order to complete this quest.
Decent. You got some blood on you by the way.
Now let's make it more challenging! Get me 40 Beef!
Bring 40 Beef in order to complete this quest.
This is much better than before!
Let's get some skins now!

quests.title: candle
steps: You want to light up the darkness?
If you want to learn how to make candles you must pass a few tests first! Make me 60 Small Candles!
Craft and bring 60 Small Candles in order to progress in your job.
Hmmm let me inspect these ... not bad at all. But this is just the basics.
60 Small Candles can hardly last a week!
Okay make me 50 Medium Candles now!
Craft and bring 50 Medium Candles in order to progress in your job.
Couldn't have done it better myself! Good job.

quests.title: carpenter
steps: You wish to learn the fine arts of carptentry?
If you wish to be my student you must show potential. Make me 25 Short Staff!
Craft and bring 25 short staff in order to progress in your job.
Show be what you got newbie! Bring me those 25 short staff
Let's make it a bit more challenging. Now make me 20 Rods!
Craft and bring 20 Rods in order to progress in your job.
Still waiting on those 20 Rods. Was this too hard for you? Haha...
Craft and bring and bring  me 15 Long Wands and 15 Long Rods!

quests.title: christmashunt
steps: Minotaurs are overly aggressive! Kill 30 of them!
Kill 30 Minotaurs to complete the quest
Brues have been stealing our toys! Kill 30 of them!
Kill 30 Brues to complete the quest
Please kill 30 Ettins!
Kill 30 Ettins to complete the quest
Kill 4 Fatal Skeletons
Kill 4 Fatal Skeletons to complete the quest

quests.title: cooker
steps: You think you have what it takes in the kitchen?
Cooking isn't for everybody! Let's see if you have the talent. Make me 20 Wheat Doughs!
Cook and bring 20 Wheat Doughs in order to progress in your job.
Heh not bad but this is basic. Everyone can do this.
Wheat Dough is the basic ingredient for many dishes. Bring me 20!
Let's see if you can actually cook now! Cook me 20 Bacons!
Cook and bring 20 Bacons in order to progress in your job.
Cooked perfectly. Ok, I'll let you in my kitchen.

quests.title: D5Blacksmith
steps: Greetings stranger! What can I do for you?
You are looking for a Blacksmith? I just happen to be one! What can I do for you?
Hmmm I see. This is indeed a particular Sword.
You say it used to be carried by the Amurtart, it's not just any Sword.
Well, as you probably already know, this is a Cursed Sword.
Cursed Swords, at least some of them, were made by Dwarves who got too close with Dark Fire.
And well, you can guess, they were smelt in Dark Fire.
This means only Dark Fire can weaken them enough to be broken.

quests.title: D5Lock
steps: Who are you? And what are you doing here?
So you've defeated the Amurtart. I have to admit I am impressed, considering she's slaughtered all my friends.
If you've read Relm's Diary, you probably know what happened to me.
I don't know if I should be thanksful of having been wounded that day or ashamed I couldn't help my friends...
Either way, I am alive now.
And I am thanksful to you for avenging my friends.
And to express you my gratitude, I hereby grant you the Mark of the Dragon Slayer.
You are now a proud Dragon Slayer and wear the Mark as proof. Congratulations !

quests.title: D5MainQuest
steps: Hello adventurer, my name is Axel. I have a story to tell you.
As you might know, some time ago a war raged between the Dragons of Light and the Dragons of Darkness.
The Dragons of Light were led the White Dragon Kathelprime and each of them had a Dragon Raja.
Dragon Rajas were people gifted with the ability to communicate with Dragons. They served as a bound between Dragons and Humans.
As for the Dragons of Darkness, they were led by the Amurtart.
Ultimately, Light won over Darkness and Amurtart was repelled.
Cataclysm was prevented and the Dragons of Light went back to sleep. Peace spread accross the continent and lasted for several years.
That was until the High families of Zypern and Vyseus started to argue over newly discovered territories.

quests.title: D5MBalroc
steps: I didn't think living would be this hard without my wife...
She was killed by a Balroc last month.
I told her it was dangerous to leave the city with all these creatures lurking around but she still left.
And now she's gone forever...
You seem like a rather strong person, would you do something for me?
I would like you kill the Balroc who's murdered my wife.
I know this won't bring her back... But at least justice will be done.
I know he's been wearing a ring. Please bring me the ring as proof you've killed him.

quests.title: D5MBlitzIfrit
steps: One more Lycan tooth perhaps... Hmmm.......
And now to add the stone and crystal... Oh, how unfortunate...
Uh? Sorry, I'm rather busy, in middle of an experiment. Come back later.
It seems I'm short of Ifrit Stones and Blitz Crystals... That's not good.
Oh what do we have here... Hello my child, what can I help you with?
You are looking for fragments to fill your tablet? Let me have a look at it.
Hmmmm, I think I have something that looks just like that.
I'm ready to give it to you if you help me first.

quests.title: D5MBWings
steps: They say there's a Crystal that's worth millions.
I wish I owned such a Crystal...
I heard the strong Balrog in the Abysses had one.. But good luck getting it from it.
Is that..? Are you giving it to me???
If only I had that Crystal...
That's... really nice of you...
I don't know what to say... Th... Thank you.
Here, take this, perhaps it'll serve you.

quests.title: D5MCyclop
steps: Damn, I don't know where it is. I think I've lost it.
Oh, hello. Sorry, I'm rather busy right now, I've lost something important.
Oh, you're that person Axel told me about. Perhaps you could help me.
Damn, where is it...
As you probably already know, we're gathering Orbs of different kinds within our Order.
And you see, I've had this Cyclop Orb. Pretty proud of finding it considering Cyclops are very strong creatures.
But I can't find it anywhere. Either I've lost it or someone's stolen it.
Either way, I'm pretty embarassed now.

quests.title: D5MDarkBear
steps: Hello sir/madam.
What a nice day, no?
I am a member of the Dragon Order.
As Axel might have told you, we are looking for strong people.
And we are also collecting somekind of Orbs some monsters seem to have.
You need pieces to fill your tablet and I need Orbs.
So, if you bring me a Dark Bear Orb, I'll give you a piece.
Thank you my friend. Here's your piece.

quests.title: D5MDFSecret
steps: What we have here... Another whimp?
You're looking for pieces for your tablet you say?
Well, today is your lucky day, I happen to have something ressembling that.
However... I will only give it to you if you prove you're a real soldier and not a worthless whimp!
Oh, you seem to be quite someone actually.
Come back to me once you've become a War Legend!
Earn 150 Dual Fame and he might reconsider.
But a real soldier serves his nation!

quests.title: D5MFatal
steps: Hello there, can you help me?
You see, tomorrow's my wife's birthday, and I haven't found her a gift yet.
She's a demanding woman, and I'd like to get her a nice piece of jewel.
I've heard some of those Skeletons in Lethe River wear pretty nice ring, think you could get me one?
What a shiny ring, I'm sure my wife will love it. Thank you.
That would be awesome if you could bring me one of these rings from the Skeletons in Lethe River.
I haven't much to reward you for what you've done but I've found this piece the other day. Perhaps you'll find it useful.
Thank you again, my wife's gonna love that ring.

quests.title: D5MGazer
steps: Hello, Axel's told me about you.
I would like you to gather a Gazer Orb for me. If you bring me one, I will give you a piece of the Tablet.
Nice job. Here, take your piece.
Bring me a Gazer Orb and I'll give you a piece of your Tablet.
Thank you for helping us collecting Orbs.

quests.title: D5MHatchling
steps: Stones are pretty, don't you think?
I like to collect the prettiest stones.
There's this stone I've always wanted to have.
It grows within the stomach of the mightiest Hatchling.
Unfortunately, I'm not a fighter, there's no way I'd kill a Hatchling on my own.
Do you think you could help me? I'll give you this other pretty stone I have in exchange.
It really looks amazing ! I have never seen such a pretty stone !
Bring me and Hatchling Stone and I'll give you this pretty piece of stone in exchange.

quests.title: D5MKeys
steps: Damn... I don't know how I'll make it past that door...
Oh, hello, I didn't hear you coming.
My name is Laerxene and I'm a Treasure Hunter.
I have been tracking a treasure for a while and I recently found out where it's hidden.
Unfortunately, there's that strong door in the way and it's locked pretty tight.
I think the Seraphims are holding the keys but I'm unsure.
And either way, I'm no fighter.
Perhaps you could help me, what do you think?

quests.title: D5MLich
steps: I can't see the future...
Kind of ironic coming from a Medium, don't you think?
You've found a revealing eye? Wow, that's impressive! Can I have it?
If only I had the revealing eye... I'd know everything!
Let me see through it...
I can see...
It's dark, very very dark.
There's fire... A lot of fire...

quests.title: D5MSuccubus
steps: Hello, I'm from the Dragon Order, I've been expecting you.
Axel's told me about you and I have a task for you. Do you think you're up for the job?
Ok so. As Axel's told you, Hegemonia has been infested with Drakes we call 'Succubus' recently.
We believe this is clearly a sign the Dragon of Dark are coming back.
I would like you to kill as many of them as you can, that will be a good training toward becoming a Dragon Slayer.
Bring me one of the Bronze Dragons they carry sometimes as proof and I'll give you a piece for your tablet.
Good job, you'll make a great Dragon Slayer. Here's your piece.
Go kill some Succubus and bring me one of their Bronze Dragons.

quests.title: D5MTurtle
steps: You seem like a strong person... I may have a job for you.
I have heard the Dragon Turtles have claws that can cut nearly anything.
I would be very interrested in having one of these claws, think you could fetch me one? I'll make sure to reward you.
Wow, it really is sharp.
Find me a claw, and I'll reward you.
As promised, here's your reward, hope you like it as well.
Ouch ! I cut my finger !

quests.title: D5MValkyrie
steps: Those damn Valkyries...
They've been coming down the tower recently and slaughtering people.
You, you look like a strong person.
Would you mind going up the tower and killing them back? I will make sure to reward you.
Bring me one of their spines as proof.
Impressive work ! Hopefully they'll think twice before coming down here now.
Go kill as many Valkyries as you can and bring me one of their spines as proof.
As promised, here's your reward for your hard work.

quests.title: D5MVampire
steps: Uh, that bitch bit me.
Good day sir.
The... Vampire... From the Undead Dungeon.
We were looking for some treasures within the Undead Dungeon with a couple of mates, and she ambushed us.
And now... Uuugh.. I'll become just like her... I can already feel the sun burning my skin.
I need to find a cure...
I have heard... A cure can be made off the stone the Vampires carry with them.
It's worth trying out.. Could you bring me one?
